blocks.text: CAPE CANAVERAL, Fla. — NASA’s Voyager 1 has phoned home from one light-day away, humanity’s first emissary to cross this monumental threshold way out in interstellar space. Flight controllers received the spacecraft’s call Thursday, exactly 24 hours after it was sent. That’s how long it took for the radio signal to traverse the more than 16 billion miles (26 billion kilometers) at the speed of light. “Voyager 1 light-day distance confirmed … Voyager 1 continues its journey into the unknown,” controller Nshan Kazaryan announced to cheers and applause.
